documented_blocker.summary: Current public user reports on the Morocco App Store describe OTP/login failures and internal-error responses. This prevents using a legitimate unauthenticated/normal-registration client session to validate the Numocity read-only station/status/tariff request shape in a safe reproducible probe.
observations: 2026-05-03: review reports failure when requesting the confirmation code
documented_blocker.interpretation: The app is still actively maintained (3.00.10 on 2026-07-28), so the blocker is not evidence that the charging service or backend is gone. It is specifically a blocker for validating request shape through a legitimate client session from public evidence alone.

safe_next_step: Continue only with passive/public client metadata or a legitimately functioning client session. Do not infer endpoint validity from generic HTTP errors and do not bypass authentication.
production_impact: No change to production station records. Do not assign Club EV-Charge as status_source or tariff_source for a station until station-specific data is validated.
